load_pretrained_audiogen: load a pretrained AudioGen model from Hugging Face for text to sound generation
set_generation_params_audiogen: set sampling, temperature, top_k, and classifier free guidance parameters for AudioGen generation
generate_audio_from_text: generate audio waveforms from text descriptions using a pretrained AudioGen model
generate_tokens_audiogen: generate discrete audio tokens from text prompts using the AudioGen language model
prepare_tokens_and_attributes: prepare conditioning attributes and prompt tokens for AudioGen audio generation
